title: The Iterative Conception Reconsidered
summary: We investigate the iterative conception of set in its most general form, allowing urelements without assuming that they form a set. We formulate this conception in two ways, as stage theory and as level theory, and develop a general theory of levels with urelements. Unlike their pure-set counterparts, the resulting stage and level theories are not set-theoretically equivalent; moreover, second-order level theory with urelements is not weakly quasi-categorical.
